strings.GAY_warrior_order_desc: For centuries, Russia was the defender of the One, Holy Orthodox Church, but the Tsars have grown lax in their duty, and the Lord struck them down, sending pestilence over pestilence over our land as punishment for their decadence. But we, the Army of Saint George, have understood that the Salvation of Russia lies in returning to Russia's roots as a land of faith, and by reviving the Faith we will gain the favor of the Lord; and with His Favor comes the fortitude necessary to smite all enemies and reclaim Russia from the invaders and from the Red Scourge of Communism.
strings.GAY_regional_unifier: State of the Order of Saint George
strings.GAY_regional_unifier_DEF: the State of the Order of Saint George
strings.GAY_our_light_in_the_darkness_desc:
Death, famine and despair. The people of Gayny suffer day after day raids from the Red Devil and the Nazi Scum... And despite all of this, they press on. The Grand Schema must take action, the Army will prevail!

Hear, ye servants of Satan! The children of God shall not succumb!
strings.GAY_with_the_lord_above_desc: Since before the times of the Revolution, people have prayed. Since before the war with the Nazi demons, people have prayed. And now, after the final collapse of Mother Russia, people pray. Pray to our Lord and Savior, for he gives Hope, that even now, in the most downtrodden of times, where nothing seems possible anymore, Russia will be reborn, Russia will prevail against all its enemies, and the Russians will return to God as His truest children.
strings.GAY_and_the_enemies_around_us_desc: As it always was in the struggle of the True Faith of Orthodox Christianity, there are enemies all around us. The supposed free democracies, which seeks to make Orthodoxy irrelevant in its “Modern Society”. Communism and Nazism, fringe schools of thought that made the Russian people into dogs that actively hunt us down for standing against their savage dogmas. Finally, the old enemy of the True Faith - muslims, infidels, enemies that have stood against Christianity the longest, and will go down the hardest. And though our enemies are numerous, we will stand strong, for the Lord!
strings.GAY_from_ploughshares_to_swords_desc: It is truly regrettable to admit, but our brave warrior monks are not enough to stand against everyone who would want us dead. The time has come to employ the help of Russia’s most numerous peoples - simple peasants. These people have suffered a lot in recent times and in the long past, so it saddens us to call them from their homes and families to war, and not as prepared as our standing army, but these people chose this land as home for a reason. They are God’s faithful, and will bear through all his greatest challenges, as they always have.
strings.GAY_for_one_day_we_must_fight: For One Day We Must Fight
strings.GAY_for_one_day_we_must_fight_desc:
“Hear ye, hear ye! 
Blessed Russian people, hear this call! 
We must take up arms in service of God! 
For the enemies are awaiting their moment to strike, 
And will not hesitate to destroy you and Holy Russia in service of their damnable beliefs! 
Blessed Russian people, hear this call! 
Hear this call and take up arms! 
For one day, we must fight!
strings.GAY_for_the_army_desc: Up until now our armed forces only ever consisted of a small contingent of warrior monks, which are fierce warriors in their own right and fervently guard our countryside, but, when compared to the forces of our larger neighbors, they’re no more than a militia. Significant changes must be made if we hope to stand our ground against all threats.
strings.GAY_for_the_lord_desc: While our nation is as Holy as the hallowed grounds of Jerusalem for those of us that are true believers, there are those that would question us at best, and actively seek to destroy us at worst. In these trying times we must prove to the skeptics and naysayers that we are God’s true messengers of Salvation, of Hope, and of Absolution. In time, these efforts will bear the most bountiful of fruits - Belief.
strings.GAY_for_the_people_desc: One of, if not The most important tenets of Christianity have always been charitability and selflessness. Helping those that are poorer than us, those more unfortunate and not as well off as us, is undoubtedly important, for it is those things that cement us as a pious and righteous nation, worthy of the title as The Land of Christ.
strings.GAY_revise_our_tactics_desc: Most of our army fight using self-taught tactics of small skirmishes and being led by the more experienced militiamen, coincidentally some of our generals are learned in the tactics of the Great War - trenches and human wave offensives. If we want to modernize in the face of constantly evolving warfare we must bring these people together and devise new tactics which will be used by our army henceforth.
strings.GAY_raids_on_the_reds_desc: Smaller army force, less weapons and other equipment, and less experience. This is a comparison we have to the vile WRRF, followers of Communism, enemy of the Faith and any pious Christian. Though, our disadvantages could be used in our favor. We will conduct raids on these snakes, small but precise strikes, aiming for their supplies and equipment. In our hands, their equipment will be used in a more “righteous” way, yes.
strings.GAY_a_message_of_redemption_desc: It is painfully obvious why the beautiful nation of Russia is no more - losing Christianity. Communist revolution brought many terrible things, but the worst of all evils was the dismantlement of the Orthodox Church in Russia. It was because of this that we lost to the Nazi bastards. Many people agree with us, and this leads to people coming in droves to our state, knowing that fervent belief and Christianity will bring back Russia from the ashes.
strings.GAY_grow_the_flock_desc: In many ways Christianity is dependent on the work of preachers and missionaries, for they were the ones that, in the ancient history of our religion, preserved the faith, and kept it burning bright within the hearts and souls of many different people. So it stands now, that their work needs to start in full force - bringing Faith to those questioning themselves and in the need of direction, if we hope to achieve anything.
strings.GAY_feed_the_hungry_desc: Truly, we face our Lord’s toughest battle yet! In no small part due to the abominable bombings from Nazi Germany the lands of Western Russia are becoming less and less habitable from the soil turning more and more impossible to cultivate any crops, even the hardy potatoes. Because of this, starvation hit our flock with full force. We can’t send people to create new farmlands in a safer place until we sustain the hungry populace, therefore we should open the stocks of conserved food underneath our monasteries to help our people.
strings.GAY_underground_workshops_desc: Nazi bombings are the bane of every Russian’s existence on the lands of Western Russia. They’re quite simply the Devil’s sickest joke - not enough to wipe us from the face of the Earth, but just enough to destroy any and all operations we want to set up. The solution is simple, though costly - we need to construct facilities under the safety of our soil, away from bombs and able to focus on creating important equipement.
strings.GAY_fortify_the_monasteries_desc: Our beautiful, wonderful places of worship - monasteries. Long have we used their sturdy walls, relied on them for protection. Ever since the times of Kievan Rus, churches and monasteries were the most protected of places in most cities and villages. Understandably, they aren’t as effective now that everyone has possible access to explosives. Still, they’re as sturdy as a star fortress, and we must capitalize on that by upgrading their defensive capabilities.
strings.GAY_clear_the_heavens_desc: Many people come into our land. Many of them are wayward travelers that look for shelter, food and drink, and may want to stay here as our citizens. But there are those that sneak into our land with sinister purposes, seeking to destroy us from within. Given the fragility of our small nation, we are forced to enforce vigilant patrols, stopping all that come into our Sacred Land, and figuring out their identity, by force if necessary.
strings.GAY_defenders_of_the_faith_desc: Militia, rag-tag band of monks, unreliable bearded guys with some PaPaShas. This is how we were called not too long ago. Now, none but the jealous enemies call us these things. We have become warriors of God, shieldbearers of Christianity, defenders of the Faith. Our people feel safe, while our enemies dread the day when they have to fight us. Hallelujah!
strings.GAY_our_sins_washed_away_desc: Christianity was famous for absolving sins of those that fought in Crusades, a righteous war for the Holy Land and the advancement of the True Faith. Problem is, we cannot declare a Crusade, because we are Orthodox, it is not in our nature. What we can do however, is promote the ideas of redemption through battle. Our cause is righteous, regardless of what skeptics say, so fight for God! Fight, and Heaven most surely awaits you on the other side!
strings.GAY_fight_for_your_salvation_desc: “Stand tall, proud warrior of Christ! Your pious march and fervent chorus strikes fear in the Unbeliever, the Heretic and the Devil! Listen now, and know that your virtues separate you from a simple trooper. Unlike them, who fight for their petty king of some Godless land, you are a true believer, you are a shield of Christianity, and should you perish on the battlefield, Heaven will wait for you on the other side, gates open, angels calling! Amen!”
strings.GAY_fight_for_the_grandschema_desc: Father Pavlov knows it best of us all, that we might be Russia’s only hope for Christianity. No other warlord in Western Russia loves the Faith, no one else holds it dear to their hearts and souls. It is thanks to Father Pavlov that our people live and pray in the safety of our churches. We must give no quarter to those that seek to disrupt that peace, that innate right to Belief.
strings.GAY_slay_the_dragons_desc: Fervent are our priests. Pious are our flock. Righteous are our warriors. Blessed are we, for we have truly turned ourselves into a force to be reckoned with. Now, we turn our eyes to the outside. Before, we were those that suffered under the hungry eye of those on our border. Time has come to turn this around, and turn our piety into a cleansing fire against all those that are against us.
strings.GAY_anoint_the_sick_desc: Disease, one of the deadliest works of the Devil, is crippling our population. Lack of food, clean water and acceptable living conditions are the prime reasons why people are getting sick, and they are all problems we have unfortunately faced. Though, as it has been since time long ago, churches and monasteries have always tended to the sick and infirm. We will continue this tradition, and help our people recover.
strings.GAY_their_plates_before_ours_desc: Our charity initiative to feed our population has begun, but already it seems like changes need to be made. Right now we are not providing enough food for everyone, every third person is left with an empty plate, which is unacceptable! A true Christian’s duty is to provide for his people, and so we will enforce fasting in order to provide for everyone that needs it more than us.
strings.GAY_show_them_true_mercy_desc:
Not all enemies deserve death. There are those that fight us not because they truly hate us, but out of misguided beliefs, because they were told to, or simply because that is all they ever knew. Those who oppose us are not beyond mercy.

They act not out of pure hatred, but from ignorance, fear or deception. As bearers of God’s image, we are called not to delight in their destruction, but instead to resist evil without hatred, to pray for their repentance, and to leave judgement alone to God, who alone knows the heart and whose mercy exceeds our understanding. For the Lord is merciful, and has always forgiven those that show true repentance.
strings.GAY_the_light_of_christ_desc:
If we ever want to reunify Russia and to save its soul, we must show the people the Light of Christ. Russia is shattered, and now we can see the fruits of pride, nationalism and atheism. A people who were once united are now scattered by war, chaos and foreign domination.

We must act to preserve the Church and to restore order. We will re-establish the moral and sacramental order, protect the Church from destruction, and make possible again a life of repentance, prayer, and communion. Our task is not to compel faith, but to prevent its extinction.
strings.GAY_the_lords_justice_for_russia_desc: There was a time when our soldiers were seen as nothing more than grunts that are only out there for themselves. Such a sad and regrettable time has now passed, and our warrior monks are finally seen for what they are - guardians of the people and those that protect the weak, selflessly and without falter. We will most assuredly not stop there however, as we pray to, one day, be the Guardians of Holy Russia.
strings.GAY_hope_for_the_sinners_desc: When we started our religious conversion efforts alongside our charity initiative we did not even hope that the results of said efforts would create such fervent belief in our nation as something that will surely reconquer Russia. And now even those that have committed crimes, like thievery and robbery, have come out in hopes for redemption, for a second chance at life. Praise the Lord! This is truly a sign that we are guided on a path to restore Holy Russia!
strings.GAY_so_we_may_build_jerusalem: So we may Build a New Gerusalem
strings.GAY_so_we_may_build_jerusalem_desc: Some may say that ambition is not something a true Christian should exercise. This is true, humility is a virtue. But these are not times that favor a humble priest, in fact God tests us in a million ways, and we must exercise ambition. Not the sinful, but pious ambition, to one day create a truly Faithful land, a new Holy Land.
strings.GAY_Destroy_the_Aryan_Cult_desc: Since it seems that the German bombing has now ended, we must launch a preemptive surprise attack on the demons and traitors in Permheim. This vile, shameful, and dark page in Russian history must be erased and forgotten forever! Those who refuse to lay down their arms peacefully in Perm will face God's judgment, and may God forgive us and them!
strings.GAY_we_came_not_with_peace_desc: Everyone takes priests lightly these days. Gone are the days where we were treated with respect, rivaling only that of the Tsar. The dreadful Revolution spat in the face of the Church, made people quickly forget the importance of Orthodoxy, and disgraced even the Patriarch, as someone no more important than a rat...
strings.GAY_but_with_a_sword_desc: ...No more! The time has come for retribution, righteous punishment of those that would look down on us, and laugh at the importance of the Church! Our people are all of the same mind - God must return to Russia. And this return will not be peaceful, as regrettable as that is. Enemies of the Faith will fall, we will make sure of that!
strings.GAY_spread_the_word_of_the_lord: Spread the Word of the Lord
strings.GAY_a_blessing_from_above_desc:
The Order of Saint George has been revitalised, thanks to the tireless efforts of Kirill Pavlov. The military has been turned from a rag-tag force into an organised standing army, a match for anyone that we might face in our campaign to unite Russia. Authority has also been centralised and order has been restored. We are far away from being worthy to restore Russia, but we are ready as we’ll ever be.

It is now or never. The time has come to march forth from Gayny, spreading the light of Christianity, anti-bolshevism and anti-facism all across Russia. Civilians and soldiers cheer on Father Kirill Pavlov as he spurs them on towards victory. In the heart of every Order Member burns a zealous flame to cleanse the Motherland of communists, fascists and democrats alike. This is our purpose to unite and save the Russian people from anarchy and tyranny, uniting the people of this once-great land, smiting down any who would see us fail. Arise, Russians! Carry the fight to the enemy! Give him not a moment’s rest!
strings.GAY_and_demons_all_around_us_desc:
As we prepare to reunify Russia, we need to be careful as enemies assail us on all sides. To the South, lies the mad men of Perm, driven to insanity, to the point that they believe they are Aryans. To the North, the West Russian Revolutionary Front, a relic of the past, still holds on to their failed ideology of communism and is intent on spreading it.

To the West, the Komi Republic is a sign of the failed experiment of democracy, and Vyatka has not yet embraced God and Christ, still believing in their pitiful Tsar, and the German bootlickers in Samara beyond them.

We are surrounded by the hordes of hell, the unfaithful and the unholy. These immoral and heathen hordes cannot claim to be the saviours of Russia.  We are the only true and legitimate saviours of Russia. S nami bog!
strings.GAY_the_suffering_of_the_faithful_desc:
It's not just the brave soldiers who got out and fight for God that suffer, the regular people suffer too, oftentimes worse during war. While we cannot prevent all of the suffering on our mission to reunify Russia, we can still try to prevent some of the harm, or at least help the people that are currently suffering.

“Whoever is generous to the poor lends to the Lord, and he will repay him for his deed.”
strings.GAY_taking_our_toll_desc: No more prayers, we sound the “all hands on deck” alarm and get ready to put the fear of God into our numerous enemies! The time is upon us - we ride to victory now, or we will never attain it. Our one and only flaw is coincidentally our biggest advantage - we are not that remarkable compared to other warlords, therefore everyone will underestimate us… Which will ultimately be their downfall!
strings.GAY_reaping_what_we_sowed_desc: We have prepared for years for his march to bring Russia back together, and our preparation has paid off. Even during this war, we are able to feed the hungry, heal the sick and clothe the cold. It pays to be prepared, and with our preparations, we are able to expand quicker than our enemies without worrying about what we’re leaving behind us.
strings.GAY_makeshift_hospitals_desc: One of Jesus' most well-known stories was his ability to heal a man who was blind his entire life. While our doctors and nurses are not like him, they will try their hardest to heal the sick and the wounded just like him. We shall set up makeshift hospitals for both our army to get our men back to health, and the civilians in every city, town and village we liberate.
strings.GAY_bless_the_guns_desc: The loyalty of our righteous warrior-monks is unquestionable, their resolve unshakable, their spirit fully resolved. It stands to no surprise that such pious soldiers of our Lord bless their weapons before going into battle… simply because it actually works! The atheists and infidels may scoff at such practices, until their skulls are penetrated with a shot that rings true thanks to said blessings.
strings.GAY_achieving_a_breakthrough_desc: For all our hard work and fervor, it is a sad reality that the enemies simply have more bodies on the frontline than us. Getting any progress will feel impossible after some time, we must act now to get around this issue! Every one of our soldiers feel that they can keep fighting more than the rabble our enemies pose, so let us give an express order to not conserve any ammo, always carry more than one sidearm, use anything in their disposal from grenades to sticks on the ground, all to secure that coveted breakthrough.
strings.GAY_bread_and_circus_desc: To make our people feel safe, we must distract them from the results of war. First off, we must fill their stomachs, we must ensure the war doesn't affect their food supply so families are still fed during the course of the war. Secondly, the church shall set up events during the war for people to attend. Feast, plays, sports, whichever we are able to hold to keep the horrors of war away from the people's minds.
strings.GAY_A_Blessing_from_saint_george_desc: Saint George, the saint our holy order is named after, was murdered by the Romans two millenniums ago. He was executed for refusing to recant his Christian Beliefs and became a martyr for holding his beliefs. Our Patron Saint has blessed our army, we can feel it, he wants the Order of Saint George to reclaim Russia from the Heretics. We can not, we will not, and we must not fail our mission.
strings.GAY_a_rifle_for_every_man_desc: Our supply of weapons currently has just enough guns for our brave fighters, but the threat of running out of said supply looms over us like a guillotine. However small our industry may be, we need to kick it into overdrive! Raise the quotas for workers, use second-rate materials, do not throw away broken guns but fix them… We need to have rifles for our men to hold if we are to win this conflict!
strings.GAY_Unyielding_in_faith_desc: No nazi sympathizer from Samara or a communist from Arkhangelsk can look at our soldiers and see anything but a threat, for they are tireless, they are fearless, but most importantly, they are pious. True belief gives them something no outsider can understand or feel, and that makes even the snot-nosed farmboy Petya a genuine threat in the face of the enemies of our Faith, for he believes, and it makes him stronger.
strings.GAY_Unfurl_the_banners_desc: The men that fight under our banners are proud of their beliefs. They fight for God, they fight for Christ, and they fight for Christianity as a whole. They fight for what they believe in. That is the Order of Saint George, an army loyal not just to Russia, but to God.
strings.GAY_Raise_the_crosses_desc: Another sound strategy used in the Crusades was large platforms with crosses that they carried into battle. While they may not have been used for combat, they filled the crusaders with holy zeal, for Jesus himself was watching over them. Emulating that in the modern day is possible, just in a different way. Every site of a successful battle shall henceforth be marked with the Holy Cross, this will not only fill our warriors with pride in their accomplishments, but also show everyone else that the agents of our Lord watch over this place now.
strings.GAY_northern_occupier_desc:
Observing how we gradually united the whole of West Russia, these lost souls in Onega completely lost their way. Yes, her mission to oppose the barbaric communists in Arkhangelsk was noble, but now they have no goal, although they are not ready to lay down their arms. Our task will be to explain to them that it is not worth exchanging the Motherland for the service of the Finnish invaders.

They should join us in our sacred journey and duty to save our Orthodox brothers and sisters from slavery in an atheistic bourgeois republic. All of us are Russians, even those who have been suffering under the Finnish occupation for 20 years, without even a chance to be heard in Helsinki and trivially gain cultural autonomy! However, it is worth warning Onega about the consequences of their refusal not to oppose our campaign...
strings.GAY_Christ_rules_the_lands_desc:
Praise be! Hallelujah! Blessed be this day, for we have triumphed! Joy and relief fills the streets, the lands of Western Russia finally stand united at long last. Years of German oppression made some people so jaded that they stopped thinking that such a feat is even possible, yet here we are, victorious!

We have become much more than a whisper in the wind; Through our faith, we are now the light of God’s will shining in a land empty of it. We must focus on our shared goal of ensuring that Christ's teachings are spread throughout Russia. We have a responsibility to make sure that His claim to rule the lands of western, and soon all of Holy Russia is acknowledged and respected by all. Amen!
strings.GAY_every_man_is_equal_in_the_gods_eyes: Every Man Is Equal In The Eyes of God
strings.GAY_a_bright_future_for_our_children: A Bright Future For Our Children
strings.GAY_at_service_of_god_and_the_people: At Service Of God And The People
strings.GAY_holy_and_desc:
Blessed be the meek, for they always find a way to the top!

This victory signifies a turning point, a mark - that we are truly on the road to true prosperity, in our Holy nation! And while there would always be those that defy our benevolent ways of reform and change, it is an undeniable fact that we have triumphed! Amen to that!...
strings.GAY_free_desc: ...One thing we should always treasure, in times of war, in times of tumultuous peace, surrounded by aggression, passive and active, is that we are, at the end of the day, all human. Humanity, that is what we should strive towards, as creatures of our Lord. And that is what I vow to accomplish for each and every one of you - Equality in Humanity. Freedoms that every Human rightly deserves!
strings.GAY_hear_the_unheard_voices_desc: Not every person is easily heard. This much is obvious, but it is even more evident now than ever before, after we have united the region. The bureaucratic strain on our newly emerged state has got the people in a vice-like grip, and we simply do not know the extent of our problems. To that extent, we must quickly set up radio communications, as the first step towards making life better for everyone.
strings.GAY_every_man_is_equal_in_the_gods_eyes_: Given our past enmity with the zealot clique under Antipin, over the question of heathens and many other things, as well as our efforts to liberalize society, it comes to no surprise that those very same heathens have now been silently waiting for our decision over their status in the Republic. Their patience should be properly rewarded with rights, however, we still need to make it clear that the True Faith shall always take precedence, especially in politics.
strings.GAY_a_place_for_everyone_desc: Our Republic is a rare sort - in a region chock full of fringe ideologues and those who have long since renounced any sort of Faith due to despair, we promote a message of democracy and belief in our Lord and Saviour. Naturally, those that want to live here have a hard time acclimatizing to this radically different environment, and if we want to avoid this becoming a major problem for us, well, we need to find them something to do, and ease their integration in society.
strings.GAY_god_loves_his_children_desc: Writing was never my strong suit, I will admit. However, what I have begun to write here is not some novel. This piece of paper, insignificant as it may seem, carries such weight that will rival even the Civil Rights act in the US, and, thanks to our nation’s nascent status, we don’t have to deal with some uppity racists blocking our path, or waiting for congress to finally pass it into the legislature. It is as our Lord intended - human rights being essential to our society!
strings.GAY_allow_parties_desc: It hasn’t been long since our Holy Republic was proclaimed, a democratic institution at its core. Our Patriarch, a believer in democratic ideals he may be, still is pretty much a dictator, which he detests greatly. A one-party democracy, this nation will not be! Introducing differing opinions will not only benefit our image, but also promote healthy competition, to always strive towards something greater.
strings.GAY_ordinary_men_rule_desc: Going back to how bureaucracy handled during the warlord period, it was deeply flawed. In hindsight, it only succeeded thanks to it being handled by our priests, we knew our people well, and they knew us. Now however, the number of bureaucrats in the clergy is simply not enough, and many are expressing outrage that only the clergy can work in this position. The solution is obvious - allow members of our flock to take up positions of bureaucrats, proven by merit.
strings.GAY_let_the_people_decide_desc: With rapid expansion - comes growing pains. Our previous administration, if you can even call it that, was one of centralized rule. An archaic system it may be, it was the superior option in dealing with the problems of a small warlord state. Those times have long since passed, and we must change with the times: to solidify our rule as rightfully democratic, and simply to do good by our people, we must decentralize, and let the people decide what is necessary for them!
strings.GAY_united_desc: ...What I feel is the worst wound we have endured, one that is unacceptable to ignore - there are generations of Russians being born without ever knowing a concept of a united Russia. Never even crossed their innocent minds, for they grow up used to this senseless conflict between fellow Russians, taught whatever ideology they happen to be born into, and it will lead to further bloodshed… I make a vow to you now, as your Patriarch, unified Holy Russia will prevail!
strings.GAY_food_for_every_mouth_desc: Starvation nearly strangled us to death not too long ago, which we managed to avoid thanks to timely measures being taken - giving our reserves back to the community. Right now we have the luxury we could only dream of in the past - owning all of Western Russia, and being able to farm and do animal husbandry without the fear of German air raids destroying all our efforts. We however still need to take care that our farmers don’t work on an empty stomach until the first crops form, as well as feed the now-expanded population. Using the reserves of defeated warlords should suffice.
strings.GAY_roof_above_all_heads_desc: Homelessness is one of the most dire outcomes for an average Russian during these trying times, and, unfortunately, it has almost become commonplace. Either driven from their home by others, or simply having lost their home to a Nazi air raid, these people need assistance, and fast. Establishing a series of shelters, and especially community homes, is necessary if we want to have proper time to restore damaged or destroyed buildings, and build new housing districts.
strings.GAY_work_for_the_unemployed_desc: In times of peace, and war, jobs are essential. With how many new territories we’ve conquered, there are two hundred times as many people left with no jobs, left by their former masters to fend for themselves. Of course, we are not heartless. Figuring out each new territory’s strong suits, and creating jobs that favor them - that is our invisible task, and we will carry it out for those people’s sake, and for the sake of Holy Russia.
strings.GAY_eye_for_an_eye_desc: Judiciary system in Western Russia, until now, was basically non-existent. Capital punishment, penal slavery, incarcerations without trial - all were common occurrences throughout the warlords. The Lord frowns upon such barbaric practices. Justice needs to be served according to the crime committed, therefore a proper, and fair, judiciary system needs to be established.
strings.GAY_help_the_poor_desc: Poverty is something I cordially despise. No one deserves it, and no one benefits from it, barring certain truly deplorable individuals. Our reforms don’t come cheap, it is clear as day. What is also clear however, is that they were all done for your sake, my flock. Further reforms will come, of course, there is still room to grow as a nation. And as we grow, the poverty rate will continue to drop, as people’s lives get better and better!
strings.GAY_tooth_for_a_tooth_desc: Healthcare. A word forgotten by most of the Russians, it faded into obscurity as medicine became a rare, expensive tool for barter and personal prestige, rather than something produced for the populace. In our regional government such petty handlings of vitally important medicine are unacceptable. We need to bring back healthcare, and give every person the right to receive medical treatment.
strings.GAY_protected_desc: ...The warlord era. This ideologically-fueled conflict between fellow Russians, a stain on our history. It defined the last decade, as we were pitted against each other while Hitler’s shadow loomed over us, terrified us to the point of only trusting those closest to us. Now the standard-bearer of the Crooked Cross lies dead in the ground! Those of you who still feel threatened by his devilish cronies, hear my vow: as your Patriarch, I will do everything in my power to protect you!
strings.GAY_organising_the_council_desc: The Patriarch’s word is absolute - even in our democratic government this much should always hold true, though perhaps not directly, passing every matter through one person never went well. Therefore, the Patriarchal Council shall be established, for state matters of utmost importance. It shall always be headed by the Patriarch, to ensure stability, and foster loyalty.
strings.GAY_a_federalised_republic_desc: Our nation is proudly stretched across Western Russia. To facilitate a well-functioning government however, we need to establish autonomy - centralisation will actively harm us due to our size. A federative system is clearly the obvious choice for us, and will help out our struggling bureaucrats with managing the nation.
strings.GAY_bless_the_men_desc: Many conservative-minded clerics that used to make up our government grow increasingly concerned that we will abandon the ways of God chasing after more and more liberties, and eventually secularize. We will not, and we shall make that abundantly clear - a Holy Russia is only as Holy as its citizens, therefore only Orthodox Christians can be allowed to participate in the government and represent us, lest we forget our ways.
strings.GAY_representing_the_people_desc: Many liberal-minded individuals that have since come to represent our government grow increasingly concerned that we will roll back to being a dictatorship of the clergy, not paying any mind to the woes of anyone who is not a True Believer. We will not, and we shall make that abundantly clear - a democratic institution is only as democratic as its representatives, therefore we must always think of our people first, lest we stop being virtuous.
strings.GAY_at_service_of_god_and_the_people_des:
We are, first and foremost, an Orthodox Republic. Faith is what drives us towards greater things, and our representatives need to show everyone their faith, even if only with a prayer:

“Almighty God, our Help and Refuge, Fountain of wisdom and Tower of strength, who knows that I can do nothing without thy guidance and help; assist me, I pray thee, and direct me to divine wisdom and power, that I may accomplish this task, and whatever I may undertake to do, faithfully and diligently.”
strings.GAY_our_state_secured_desc: Certain people in direct opposition to our rule spelled certain doom for us, that we would fail to establish a functioning government over all of Western Russia, having been one of the smallest states in the region. How wrong have they been, for our Patriarch has delivered unto us not only a stable government, but instilled hope for the future in the hearts of our people, and plenty of desire to improve. Praise be!
strings.GAY_the_holy_government_desc: It brings me great joy to see so many different bright minds come together as one for the sake of our people. Governing over the bountiful land of Holy Russia will not be easy, but what I’ve witnessed recently grants me confidence that we can reunite Russia, and accomplish great things, with time and effort. And of course, you can always expect me to work for your sake, twice as hard!
strings.GAY_unconditional_faith_desc: ...And here we are. As we strive towards greatness, guided by the light of our Lord, we have become quite the sight to behold. However, reforms are a fickle thing - yesterday’s liberal is tomorrow’s conservative, and we cannot become complacent. Progress, by definition, always moves forward, and we simply mustn't stop working on fixing our mistakes, of past and present. So follow me, dear people of our Holy Russia, for the Lord smiles upon us!
strings.GAY_the_republics_army_desc: Thanks to our army, we were able to reunite Western Russia. However, with this new massive territory, we need to manage, the army will have to undergo many surgical reforms to make it into a proper Russian army that the Republic needs. To need an army that can reclaim our country all the way to Magden, we will need to change the current religious militias into a massive, modern army.
strings.GAY_organising_our_forces_desc: Just a few years ago, we controlled only a tiny bubble of territory. Now we hold onto almost all remaining Russian territory west of the Urals. Unsurprisingly, this took a heavy toll on our army organisation, with our forces stretched severely thin within our reconquered land. Our Military leaders will establish new supply chains and outposts to reorganise our men. We will also train new regiments so we can properly protect ourselves from any elements that wish to destabilise us.
strings.GAY_study_american_training_methods_desc: While we slowly create a new army for our Republic, it’s become clear to us that we need new standardised training methods if we are to form a formidable army. We shall look to the American army and study their training regimes. We will use our contacts in the United States to request American advisors to train our men and to send some of our own men to the States to be personally trained by the American War Machine. If the Reich is to be destroyed, it will be done by the world’s free nations.
strings.GAY_arm_our_soldiers_desc: Weapon development in Russia ground to a halt when the Bolsheviks were effectively curb-stomped by the Reich. What was left was shabby workshops which made guns which were made from parts of other guns. We ourselves even just took whatever guns we could, with little standardisation. We need new standardised weapons for our men. Our gunsmiths will create a new automatic rifle based on the old Kalashnikov rifle from the war with the Germans, which will be put into the hands of every regular solider in our army.
strings.GAY_mechanise_our_infantry_desc: Ask a soldier to run 50 miles, he won’t be there until the moon has risen. Ask a truck driver to drive 50 miles, he’ll be there in an hour. The Russian territories are massive, to the point that men travelling by foot is a waste of time and resources when we can drive them much faster over a much larger area. With new truck assembly plants being set up across the country, we purchase a fleet of trucks for our men. With these new wheels, we can move our men around the front with lightning speed.
strings.GAY_psychological_preparation_desc: A rifle is only useful in the hands of a man who’s willing to pull the trigger. We need our men to pull that trigger without hesitation or fear. We need men who will be daring soldiers ready to sacrifice themselves for a United Russia. We will drill into our men's heads that they must be prepared to fire on fellow Russians in order to reclaim our country and then on the Germans to drive them out of Moscow. When the clock strikes for the stampede east, our men will be ready, psychologically driven and determined.
strings.GAY_our_republics_finest_armour_desc: During our conquest of Western Russia, we had almost no tanks, barring a few captured by other warlords. The only statelet that was able to mass produce tanks was Chernyakhovsky in Gorky, and even he fell eventually. However, the lack of tanks for many warlords provides us with an opportunity. If we are to produce new tank divisions for our army, this will give us a massive advantage as their sheer firepower can wipe out whole squads of men. These tanks will be the first ones over the Urals to the reunification of Russia.
strings.GAY_armed_disciplined_and_ready_desc: A man in the Republic's army a few years ago would’ve had a gun created in 1941, quivered at the mere sight of the enemy and had no means of transportation. Now this same man has a brand-new rifle from the gunsmith benches, is mentally prepared to shoot any enemy to Russia in sight and can hop on a truck to wherever he’s needed. If he’s lucky, this man may even be able to ride atop one of the army’s tanks fresh off the assembly line. Our men are ready, and our enemies are not.
strings.GAY_restructuring_the_high_command_desc: Thanks to our great generals, we were able to sweep away any opposition we met. However, some of these generals have ‘Radical’ ideas on religion. Many of these same generals are also loyal to Antipin. If we keep these men in charge, they could become a destabilising factor in our Republic. To prevent this, we shall replace these nutcases with more competent men, who are still loyal to God, but who will keep the security of our nation first and foremost.
strings.GAY_the_rules_of_war_desc: Everyone has a story of soldiers that were supposed to protect, committing atrocious crimes against them. Burned villages, mass graves, extortion, we have all been subjected to the whims of disloyal men, even a few of our own men were reported as complicit in such crimes. We will write new rules of war for our men to follow, and they will follow. To enforce these rules, we will also ensure whistle-blowers can report wrongdoing by our soldiers. We are the protectors of this land, we must act like it.
strings.GAY_outmaneuver_our_enemies_desc: A few generals have proposed a tactic on how to deal with the warlords in the east once we begin our march. They proposed that we utilise our trucks and tanks in the army to outflank and outmanoeuvre any enemies in our way. At first, they’ll think we’re only attacking in front of them, but soon they’ll discover we’re attacking them from their ideas and even behind them as well. Speed is key, and soon we will be driving circles around our foes.
strings.GAY_forcing_a_breakthrough_desc: One of the newly promoted generals has devised a solution on how to face our enemies. He’s proposed that we produce large amounts of artillery and shells to destroy our rivals and their positions before our troops even fire a round. We can soften up or even defeat our enemies before our men rush in and finish the job. Those defences are helpful when they’re intact, but they won’t protect them against anything once we shatter them to pieces.
strings.GAY_dominate_the_skies_desc: The Skies of our country have been empty ever since the last German bombing raid after Hitler’s death. During our conquest, planes were still a rare sight. Thus, we will finally set up an air force, and this air force will be the largest in Russia. We will overwhelm our enemy with the sheer volume of planes we have.
strings.GAY_strategic_bombing_desc: We all remember the destructive power of the German Bombers, destroying everything and anything they could find. However, we can learn from this. We now know of the power a single bomber does. We will set up a new air force whose main priority will be the bombardment of enemy positions. Once the declaration of war has been sent, our planes will fly into the skies and destroy anything useful the enemy has. We will adapt.
strings.GAY_lions_led_by_lions_desc: Our restructuring of the army’s high command and reform of our military tactics have been a stunning success. Previously, some of our men were blinded by faith and zealotism. Now we have competent men loyal to the Lord and to the Republic. Previously, we had no tactics, all our men did was run at the enemy. Now our men have proper plans and tactics to follow, while pilots will assist them from the sky. We have come a long way to get to where we are now.
strings.GAY_at_the_protection_of_liberty_desc: Once upon a time, we were simple followers of God, with no nation, no proper army, just some religious militias and loyalty to the lord. Now we have a real army, an army loyal to God, loyal to the Republic, and most importantly, loyal to Russia. Our followers range from the private who has finished his training, to the lieutenant commanding his first raid, to the airman ascending the sky once again and finally to the General planning the cross over the Urals. We have come far, we have overhauled our army, but our values and loyalties still remain.
strings.GAY_the_worlds_eyes_upon_us_desc: After the fall of the Soviet Union, most of the civilized world didn’t exactly shed a tear for the Russians, and the years of turmoil they were thrown into. So it comes as a big shock to us, that several free nations of the world expressed their happiness over our emergence as a regional power, capable of reuniting Russia. Their help would be beneficial to us, so let us play their diplomatic games, and make as many friends as possible!
strings.GAY_our_friends_in_america_desc: United States of America. They were the first to extend their interest in our endeavors, despite our history as a theocracy and only having a fledgling democratic institution. It is clear that their struggle with Japan, and, more importantly to us, Germany, needs a major wildcard. A wildcard like Russia. We will help them understand that they need us, and we will naturally accept any help they can provide in our righteous cause.
strings.GAY_the_aid_of_uncle_sam_desc: Because of the aforementioned struggle that the US has against Japan and the Nazis, and also not entirely trusting us, they can’t exactly throw their entire weight behind us. Fortunately, there’s plenty of help that can come from under the table. Our secure communications line with the US has the CIA on the line, and they got guns they are raring to give to allies of democracy. Spasibo, Dyadya Sam!
strings.GAY_invite_their_corporations_desc: One thing the Americans love us more over the other warlord states is our desire to enter the free market. Brands like Coca-Cola and McDonalds have already sent out letters expressing their interest in expanding their operations in our nation. Thankfully, unlike the corporate hellhole of Japan, they don’t demand every ounce of our natural resources, all they desire is profit, which we are more than happy to indulge in as well!
strings.GAY_united_in_freedom_desc: We are quite different from our American friends, especially in our history, and our cultural values. However, it is true when they say when opposites attract, though in this case we attract with something else as well - our aspirations towards freedom. Though we may have been quite alien to each other, our people quickly view each other as friends and allies, clearly, we are a match made in Heaven!
strings.GAY_european_diplomacy_desc: Europe’s relations with Russia had always been strained, to put it lightly, plenty of which can be attributed to our Orthodox Faith. Times of religious conflicts have long since passed however, and now most of Europe is under the German jackboot. Thankfully, a few free nations survived, and establishing healthy, and hopefully friendly, relations with them will help us tremendously.
strings.GAY_overtures_to_the_pope_desc: The Great Schism happened almost nine hundred years ago. Since then, Roman Catholics and Greek (and then Russian) Orthodox churches have ceased any and all communications, denouncing and deeming each other heretical from that point forward. The time has come to thaw our relations, as Christianity is slowly becoming completely irrelevant in the modern world, it is simply a fact that we need to come together for the sake of our Lord, and hopefully put aside our differences.
strings.GAY_a_bridge_to_italy_desc: One might look at the nation of Italy and see a nation of enemies - the birthplace of Fascism, which used to be allied to Germany and even fought against us in the Great Patriotic War. Our Patriarch however, sees a nation of potential friends - from war to football, the people of the peninsula are a wall against the Devil to the North, and so we shall sway them to our cause, whether they want to or not.
strings.GAY_denounce_the_german_devil_desc: Monsters, jackals, madmen. There are many choice words for the stain on world’s history that is the German Reich and their people. Followers of an ideology fueled by hatred, they carved a deep wound in our world, and many of their people’s hands shall always be stained with blood. It is our duty to remind them that Germany needs to be purified, and the people liberated from the Nazi menace, so they can see the light of our Lord, and turn to the beacon of democracy.
strings.GAY_our_place_in_the_sun_desc: There were plenty of people who could not really put a finger on what to think of our nation, a theocracy-turned-democracy, and yet, having only just now gained access to international relations, we have enjoyed plenty of friendly exchanges with the Free World, and this is just the beginning. We have left our less-than splendid isolation, and now we look optimistically towards the future.
strings.GAY_the_government_representing_god_and_: The Government, Representing God And The People
strings.GAY_Our_orthodox_republic_the_shining_be: Our Dear Republic, Shining with the Light of Christ
strings.GAY_Uranium_the_new_blood_of_christ: Uranium: The New Blood Of Christ
strings.GAY_continue_spreading_the_word_of_god: Continue Spreading the Word of God
strings.GAY_gods_land_is_all_we_need: God's Land is All We Need
strings.GAY_form_the_holy_order_of_military_affa: Form the Holy Order of Military Affairs
strings.GAY_reach_out_to_the_greek_orthodox_patr: Reach Out to our Orthodox Brothers
strings.GAY_crippling_famine_desc: The lands controlled by the Army are in no way rich. These last months, the situation spiraled out of control, with hundreds of deaths each day that passes. If we wish to endure the hardships of warlord Russia, the Army must act now.
strings.GAY_beacon_of_russian_orthodoxy_desc: The Army is the last state that represents Russian Orthodoxy with pride. We will not falter against the infidels.
strings.GAY_march_desc: Heretics, all around us! Our warriors are emboldened by the righteous cause they fight for - Saint George will bring us victory!
strings.GAY_the_great_struggle_desc: We are surrounded by heretics! We shall fight until our last breath, for the glory of Christ!
strings.GAY_the_great_struggle_new_desc: We are surrounded by heretics! We shall fight until our last breath, for the glory of Christ and Russia!
strings.GAY_power_of_god: Seeing might of the true faith, thousands upon thousands inspired souls flock to out cause
strings.GAY_surrounded_by_heathens_desc: We are surrounded by heathens, but they will never crash us, for God is with us!
strings.GAY_administration_purged_desc: Weed in the garden... Heretics, heatherns, atheists, satanists and others have infiltrated our administration. But thankfully father Antipin knows how to deal with them.
strings.GAY_military_purged_desc: During the godless bolshevik rule, many heathens have gotten into the army. We lost to Germans because of them. Thankfully father Antipin already took the steps required to deal with it.
strings.GAY_kingdom_of_christ_desc: We are finally living the way God intended!
strings.GAY_one_against_all_desc:
Our destiny draws near! Far from the once-warlord state we were, we are now the last bastion of true Christian morality in the Russian lands, fighting for its soul against impossible odds.

Do not rest not a minute, do not give in to fear, and do not forget what we are fighting for! We are fighting for Christ and the Holy Spirit, against godlessness and satanism that has infested our Motherland. We are fighting for every last one of our family, neighbors, village and city. We are fighting a great holy war, one whose ferocity hasn't been matched in centuries. We are fighting to redeem Russia! So grab your weapons, your spirits, and let the storm break loose!
strings.GAY_commission_of_military_affairs_idea: Preparation of the Military Affairs Committee
strings.GAY_the_military_and_autarky3: High Qualification for a Militarized Autarky
strings.GAY_trade_with_the_tsar_desc: We concluded a mutually beneficial agreement with the Tsar of Vyatka, who believes in our good intentions for the “religious salvation of the Russian people”. In practice, however, he has such a loss of understanding of reality due to the abuse of alcoholic beverages that he does not assume even the slightest possibility of our refusal to submit later. For now, in any case, we can give up a part of our economic sovereignty if the survival of our political and cultural life requires it.
strings.GAY_candidate_action_in_progress: The candidate is now taking action
strings.GAY_Candidate_mechanic_available_tt: The Candidate Mechanic is now Active!§

strings.GAY_GUI_mil_statistics_additional_text_t: Looking at all our actions in this direction, we currently have this result of militarization.
strings.GAY_militarization_information_tt:
This is the GUI for checking the overall militarization of your army. Militarization is primarily increased and decreased via this screen. Here you can directly determine whether you want to spend more on the army and get buffs, or weaken the army and apply debuffs.

On the left side, you spend your £political_power_texticon political power to increase the percentage of militarization, improving army buffs, but in return receiving debuffs in non-military sectors.

On the right side, you do the opposite: you gain £political_power_texticon political power in exchange for a decrease in the militarization percentage, receiving debuffs for the army, but in return you receive buffs in non-military sectors.

After interacting with one of the actions, you need to wait for a 60-day cooldown to continue your actions again.

strings.GAY_mechanic_explanation:
MILITARIZATION 
Militarization is primarily increased and decreased via this screen. Higher militarization will increase army bonuses at the cost of economy and stability. Lower militarization will do the opposite. 
TERRITORY CONTROL AND FACTIONS 
This mechanic is primarily controlled from the decision tab. The Army of Saint George is contains three main power blocks. The common people, the clergy of the Church, and the wealthy few. Each group controls a certain amount of territory, a certain amount of strength, and holds varying degrees of loyalty to the central government. Higher loyalty will lead to larger bonuses from the factions while low loyalty will result in maluses. Factional territory control confer bonuses scaling with percentage held. However the state also gainst bonuses from holding territory. If the proportion state controlled territory drops too low, massive debuffs will be incurred. 
Certain concessions may also be granted to the factions. The effectiveness of these scal with factional strength. These may be granted or revoked at any time, but revoking concessions lowers loyalty. Be aware, factions with low loyalty confer debuffs when holding concessions rather than buffs. 
You may ignore this mechanic if you choose, but at the very least don't let state controlled territory get too low.

strings.GAY_No_Victor: No One is powerful enough to control the Order.
strings.GAY_THENEWORDER_DESC:
As the Soviet Union cracked under pressure, each man found ways to cope with the oncoming collapse. Some turned to Fascism; some turned to Democracy; some to their primal instincts of survival. As Kirill Pavlov crawled through the tundra, injured and dying, he turned to God. 

From this awakening sprung a new state in the outskirts of Western Russia, the Army of Saint George, the movement's adherents hiding out in the fortified monastery of Gayny and biding their time, waiting for the end of the German bombardments. But the seeming monolith is cracked; the mainstream Pavlov’s rump state is protected by the Orthodox militias of the fanatic convertee Mikhail Antipin, the alliance under constant strain, with the discord only worsened by the democratic preacher Sergey Izvekov. 

As the Russian Anarchy rages on, it is up to the Army to bring God back to Russia. Whether that God is of the New Testament or the Old remains to be seen.
strings.GAY_declare_war_on_opposite_tt: We will declare war on the remaining neighbour warlord
strings.GAY_Interaction_cooldown_tt: We need to wait 60 days before using another militarization interaction!
strings.GAY_failed_choice_tt: Ensure that one of the candidates has an advantage over the other. You must not get a tie! (NOT: No One is powerful enough to control the Order.)
strings.GAY_news.4.desc: In the hills and ravines of Mexico, people go to their local church every Sunday to get themselves closer to God, and to find solace in their lives. It is a generational practice that most Mexicans have been doing for all their lives, but recently, a new form of the Christian cross is becoming well known amongst the population. Both in the cities and the villages all across the nation, an burgeoning Orthodox community is rising across all social classes. Where the Catholic Church has long been seen as a corrupt, reactionary instrument of PRI rule, the Orthodox priests there, coming from the Russian Anarchy, have helped out ordinary citizens and done charitable acts for the needy members of society, which has resulted in the increasing popularity of the church. In response to such events, the Catholic Church has undergone their own social program to boost popularity amongst the Mexican public, yet the Orthodox Church is set to become a new religious force in the nation, with 5% of the population expected to become Orthodox Christians by the end of this decade.
strings.GAY_news.4.a: Saint Peter in Mexico City? How preposterous!!
strings.GAY_news.1.desc:
Everyone knew that Russia would rise again, even if they didn`t say it out loud. It was only a matter of time before the nation rose again from the ashes to make the world tremble once more. But of all the possible contenders to reunite the country, this one was the least expected.

The inevitable has happed: Russia now stands as a united nation, only the people ruling it were different. The Orthodox Church now rules Russia for the first time in its history, with its Patriarch Kirill I as its head. Russia is now the first of its kind in the modern world. A state guided by God, the words and principles of the Bible now run the Russian machine, with its citizens loyal servants of the Church, religious minorities forced to convert, and political opposition and secularism a thing of the past. But whatever its ideology, it is now clear that the Russian bear has finally awakened from its long slumber, and the whole world will now see the true wrath and power of God as the bear's attention turns to the West.
strings.GAY_news.2.desc:
The Russian Orthodox Church had never held a position of power before. Its existence was dedicated to serving the Tsar until the Communists attempted to destroy it. Nobody anticipated their ascent to power during the nation's darkest hour, yet now Eurasia quakes as they have emerged.

For the first time in 30 years, Russia stands united, now under the rule of Pimen I, the Patriarch of the Russian Orthodox Church, who has introduced a new kind of democracy unseen across the world. A democracy guided by the wisdom of God, with all political parties, from the left to the right, supporting Christian theology. Already, new elections are have been slated next year, with former secular politicians joining ranks and running for the country's newly formed parliament and prime minister posts. Such a system has gained a few followers back home, though it is only limited. And with the Patriarch having announced plans to reclaim forner Russian land, it is obvious now to all, that the world has entered a new age, and it will never be the same again.
strings.GAY_news.3.desc:
Shocking news has emerged from Russia, news that was anticipated but has nevertheless stunned most of the world. The Russian Anarchy has ended, and a new, terrifying force has reunited the nation.

Having began as a small warlord state in Western Russia, the Kingdom Of Christ has reunified the nation under the absolute rule of the Russian Othodox Church and its Patriarch, Peter II. This new Russia is a militaristic, totalitarian state run by religious zealots and fanatics with state oppression towards religious minorities committed in the name of God. The state has declared open hostility to all three of the world`s superpowers, with announced plans to deal with the “Satanic” Germans first and reclaim Moscow and the rest of the eastern Reichskommisariats. One thing is for certain: the whole world now fears the Russian beast, and second by second, the clock ticks closer to Armageddon.
strings.GAY_news.5.desc:
The Father of All Rus', {gay_getleader}, upon arriving at the ruins of liberated Moscow, proclaimed the victory of Orthodoxy over the Nazi monster. In doing so, he sent a message not only to the weakened fascists of Europe, but also to the entire world order, which until that moment had underestimated the leadership abilities of the clergy.

This atypical Christian government announced plans to spread Orthodox dogma and provide emergency aid to these newly acquired territories of the former Reichskommissariats. Instead of laws, the population adheres to the commandments of the Bible and the Gospel, and all non-Orthodox citizens are forced to accept the new order of things. Nevertheless, the loss of the eastern territories has struck a massive blow to Reich's economy, prestige, and military, and it remains to be seen how the German people will react.
strings.GAY_news.6.desc:
No one could have imagined that a provincial, militaristic priest would lead Russia and guide the new Kingdom of Christ into a holy war to take revenge against the fascists and Nazis in Europe. While tanks, trucks, and infantry set off on a crusade to the west, Father Mikhail Antipin announced that his country was declaring war on the entire Einheitspakt. The true motives behind this decision have yet to be revealed, but it is clearly a matter of a self-sacrificing religious war against the earthly embodiment of Cain and his demonic minions.

German Officials appear baffled by the notion that a government focused around, as they claim, 'dogmas and commandments of Christianity' can match the might of the Einheitspakt's military-industrial complex. Nevertheless, the Wehrmacht is on full combat alert, ready to repel any attacks by “Orthodox fanatics”. The world watches on, intrigued, as the world's most religious army wages a desperate struggle against the Nazi demon dominating Europe.
strings.GAY_news.6.a: What could be worse than that - God's judgment?
strings.GAY_news.7.desc:
Today, Father Sergey Izvekov and the leadership of the Orthodox Republic of Russia officially declared war on the Reich, citing violations of ceasefires along the border, the occupation of 'spiritually Russian Christian lands', and the need to 'save all the faithful and long-suffering Christians of Russia'. Outdated military transport vehicles, poor-quality copies of modern tanks, and motivated soldiers now march into RK Moskowien in boots that are several years old.

German Officials appear baffled by the notion that a government focused around, as they claim, 'dogmas and commandments of Christianity' can match the might of the Einheitspakt's military-industrial complex. Nevertheless, the Wehrmacht is on full combat alert, ready to repel any attacks by “Orthodox fanatics”. The world watches on, intrigued, as the world's most religious army wages a desperate struggle against the Nazi demon dominating Europe.
strings.GAY_news.7.a: In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit!
strings.GAY_news.8.t: {get_newspaper_header}The Russian Orthodox War Against Nazi-Occupied Europe
strings.GAY_news.8.desc:
Today, every Russian church bell rang three times as the Holy Russian State officially declared war on the Greater Germanic Reich. Father Kirill Pavlov delivered a passionate and religious speech to his people, promising to put an end to National Socialist tyranny and oppression in Eastern Europe and restore Russia's status as the leading Orthodox superpower. Thousands of consecrated armored vehicles are racing across the endless plains of RK Moskowien.

German Officials appear baffled by the notion that a government focused around, as they claim, 'dogmas and commandments of Christianity' can match the might of the Einheitspakt's military-industrial complex. Nevertheless, the Wehrmacht is on full combat alert, ready to repel any attacks by “Orthodox fanatics”. The world watches on, intrigued, as the world's most religious army wages a desperate struggle against the Nazi demon dominating Europe.
strings.GAY_news.8.a: And even the earth trembled under the weight of sins...
strings.GAY_purges_started: The Purges of the Unfaithful have begun
strings.GAY_purges_category_desc: We are advancing greatly in our monumental effort to cleanse Russia from enemies of god, but still there is much to be done. We shall burn out the heresy, with no doubt, no pity, no mercy! IN THE NAME OF GOD!
strings.GAY_purge_agnostics_desc: Agnostics do not reject the god directly, but they neither reject ideology of our enemies. They are not with us, and therefore against us, and therefore must be purged in the name of God almighty and our Lord Jesus Christ.
strings.GAY_purge_kostroma_desc: There goes a rumor, that Kostroma became a safeheaven for witches, time to change that. Every suspicious woman in the region will undergo swimming test.
strings.GAY_purge_viatka_desc: It came to out attention that there are some priests in Viatka who teach to much about love and devotion and to little about divine cleansing, let us purge them and their followers.
strings.GAY_purge_samara_desc: Samara is the place where traitorous fascist collaborators once resided. We will track down their remains and force them march in the wide fields... ...in Spanish shoes, till they expire!
strings.GAY_purge_perm_desc: We have already got rid from most of the nazis residing in Perm, but some reports indecate that few remain, we will crusify them on their crooked crosses.
strings.GAY_purge_tyumen_desc: Godless Bolshevik sympathizers still remain in these lands, it is time to change that.
strings.GAY_purge_omsk_desc: While the methods used by the Black are godly, while their ideology is close to true cristian morals, they are still astray and must be delt with.
strings.GAY_purge_gayny_desc: Some priests close to Antipin have deviated from the godly path and doubt out latest policies. Send them to hell!
strings.GAY_purge_intelectuals_desc: Blessed are the ignorant. Knowledge is a poison. An intenectual today, an atheist tommorow. Antipin solution to this is killing all the students with grades 2 standart deviations above from the mean(or more).
strings.GAY_purge_atheists_desc: Atheists are just ungratefull acne on the face of earth, and must be dealt with accordingly.
strings.GAY_purge_heretics_desc: Heretics do not deserve to be crusified, being close to our symbol would be to generous. Antipin decided to kill them via Scaphism.
strings.GAY_purge_heathens_desc: Heathens shall be buried alive, being a fertilizer is the best thing they can do for us anyway.
strings.GAY_purge_sinners_desc: Dante was a heretical Catholic, but in his divine comedy he described the sins well. If anybody will be caught, or suspected to be comminting one of the sins described there, will meet a slow and painfull death on a cross.
strings.GAY_purge_unloyal_desc: The unloyal individuals will be hanged, or executed by a firing squad.
strings.GAY_purge_skeptics_desc: A skeptic, like an intelectual is a potential atheist. A skeptic is potentially unloyal. Any skeptic must meet a death by drinking a poison.

strings.GAY_warlord.2.desc:
Today was a harsh day, Dimitri was coming back from the farmlands after hours of plowing. As he opened the door to enter the house a small grey blur embraced him by the waist: “Daddy, what are we eating this evening?”, asked Anatoly loudly , one of his sons. His words hit him like a truck, even after so much work and blood spilt, he couldn’t even afford to buy a simple meal for his children... “Sorry sweetheart, but we don’t have much for today, but at least we should be able to hold off our hunger for another day...” he replied; seeing the his child's enthusiasm deflate was more painful than a gunshot... The results of his failures as a father. 

The day went on as usual, he played around with his children during the evening, took care of his ailing wife and started preparing dinner. “There’s nothing more than this?” asked Ekaterina, his oldest daughter, “Why we never have money for food? You MUST ask for more Father! The fat pig surely could spare more coin for us, the conditions you work in are-” “ENOUGH!” shouted Dimitri, “Smirnov already has to pay other 200 farmers, do you think he can raise the wages of everyone? Ekaterina, you must understand it’s not just us, everyone in this damn village is struggling with their lives, you can’t require better treatment than the others.” 

 As he shut his mouth someone knocked at the door. Dmitri went to open it, he was greeted by a Priest of the army, holding a basket of bread on his hand. “Good evening, brothers and sisters, I come on behalf of the Grand Schema. We have been armyed us to distribute some loafs of bread for each family in this village, are you in need of some?” Dimitri couldn’t believe it: free bread? The children started cheering the man as he gave them the food they needed. Dimitri still remembered the days of Bukharin, four of his brothers have died of starvation, while the communists bickered between each other. Maybe the arrival of the army was for the better? 

Dimitri said a quick prayer and thanked the priest.
strings.GAY_warlord.2.a: Even the smallest actions can save lives
